title: Microsoft Purview: improved built-in sensitive information types
summary: The briefing passes: its roadmap dates, inspection and copying controls, and product-level licensing statements are supported. It distinguishes existing sensitive information type behaviour from the planned improvement, whose default, affected definitions and separate licensing remain unpublished.

claims.quote: Improved Microsoft out-of-the-box sensitive information types (SITs) to identify sensitive data more precisely and reliably.

claims.claim: The same SIT can produce different detection results in Exchange, SharePoint and OneDrive, and Endpoint DLP.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.model and notes; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: The included product-level entitlement for Microsoft 365 and Windows/macOS endpoint assets is Purview's Microsoft 365 E3/E5/A5/F5/G5 per-user model.
claims.quote: The per-user licensing model is the familiar Microsoft 365 E3/E5/A5/F5/G5 model. It remains unchanged. This licensing model enables you to apply Microsoft Purview controls and protections to Microsoft 365 and Windows/macOS endpoint-based assets.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: An E5 licence is required to use credential scanning SITs.
claims.quote: E5 license is required to make use of credential scanning SITs.

claims.quote: E5 license is required to make use of credential scanning SITs. For a list of all the credential scanning SITs, see All credentials sensitive information types.

claims.quote: The RecommendedConfidence property of the returned objects contains a value that represents the default (or recommended) confidence level that should be used with the corresponding sensitive information type.
